releaseNotes: Adds Bluetooth to Whole House through LocalWave's Output Fabric. The active Android Bluetooth route can coordinate with supported Roku and Samsung/DLNA outputs, with conservative latency estimates, bounded manual trim, explicit route state, and fail-closed local behavior on route loss. Existing normal Bluetooth, wired, Android Auto, Cast, Roku, Samsung/DLNA, DSP, ReplayGain, EQ, and single-output playback remain isolated.
